title: Distance to a plane is controlled by the distance to a nearby plane
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, P and Q linear subspaces of R^{n+l} with orthogonal projections p_P = P.starProjection and p_Q = Q.starProjection, and x in R^{n+l}. Then dist(x, P) <= dist(x, Q) + hsNorm(p_P - p_Q) ||x||, where dist(x, S) = infDist x S and hsNorm is the Hilbert-Schmidt norm (hsNorm A = sqrt(hsNormSq A), hsNormSq A = sum_i ||A e_i||^2).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (P Q : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ)) (x : Amb n ℓ), infDist x (P : Set (Amb n ℓ)) ≤ infDist x (Q : Set (Amb n ℓ)) + hsNorm (P.starProjection - Q.starProjection) * ‖x‖
